decision: Binance absolute imbalance threshold produced one signal; normalization required. ASTER comparison re-ranks SHORT separately and rechecks QA at delayed entry. All data periods inspected. Funding proxy TARGET only.

protocol.signal: At each 3h UTC boundary, completed previous 24h H1 kline, actual taker buy share. 3h signed taker imbalance opposite 3h price return, abs imbalance>=.15, recent3h volume vs prior21h >=1.5; direction of price, SHORT only. Source independent. Binance and ASTER separate volume scales; not merged. Highest abs imbalance*volume ratio among eligible symbols per arm. ASTER tradability only uses original R3 causal QA.
protocol.definitions: BOTH both venues independently detect absorption same symbol/side at same time; PRICE ASTER prior3h down; NOT_BULL ASTER BTC3h<=0; LAG Binance3h return below ASTER3h by >=0.5 percentage points; M5/M15/H1 wait first closed candle below origin open and bearish, max3h, original QA rechecked at most recent completed H1 plus preceding 48h M5 nonzero ratio>=.75. No re-ranking after confirmation.
protocol.exits: H24/H48 fixed and TP8 at each horizon, STOP8 conservative same-bar stop first; adverse gap; gross .30 2 slots, 12h cooldown, 10/30bps. Fixed boundary exclusions before replay. Funding sensitivity TARGET only if all rates archived, actual signed funding based on M5 mark proxy; funding cashflows included chronologically in equity, entry and exit boundary events excluded with explicit count.
protocol.controls: 32 same-timestamp alternative-symbol placebo for every fixed H48 arm with >=2 positive periods and BINANCE/H24, BINANCE/H48, BOTH/H48, ASTER/H48. Exact side and exit. Controls match QA not signal; for delayed entries use same delayed timestamp. No independent periods.
protocol.limits: Data Binance archive monthly through Oct2026, daily through Nov25; 26 daily absent outside entry period. No OI/board/liq in this run. All periods previously inspected.
